evidence.title: Moratoriums In Place In Mayville, Chautauqua Town Regarding Green Energy
evidence.supports: Confirms the Village of Mayville (a distinct government from the Town of Chautauqua, which separately adopted its own wind-energy moratorium the same period) passed a one-year moratorium on new battery energy storage systems in June 2025.
evidence.quote: During the recent village board meeting, Mayville leaders passed a one-year moratorium on new battery energy storage systems.

evidence.title: New York BESS Moratoriums: 90 Active Battery Storage Restrictions
evidence.supports: September 2026 update specifically dates a Village of Mayville renewal to May 2026, now expiring June 2027.
evidence.quote: Chautauqua County remains the densest moratorium cluster in the state with 9 active moratoriums, now including Village of Mayville (enacted May 2026, expiring June 2027).

evidence.title: Town of Westfield Town Board minutes and Resolution No. 21 of 2026 / Local Law No. 1 for the Year 2026, March 4, 2026
evidence.supports: Directly confirms the row's account: the Town Board held a public hearing and unanimously adopted Resolution No. 21 of 2026 enacting Local Law No. 1 for the Year 2026, extending the commercial BESS moratorium (originally imposed by Local Law No. 1 of 2024) through March 1, 2027.
evidence.quote: RESOLUTION TO ADOPT LOCAL LAW NO. 1 OF 2026 A LOCAL LAW TO EXTEND THE MORATORIUM ON COMMERCIAL BATTERY ENERGY STORAGE SYSTEMS... By Local Law No. 1 of 2024, the Town Board of the Town of Westfield enacted a moratorium on the processing and approval of new applications for commercial battery energy storage systems that lasted through March 1, 2027... Local Law No. 1 of 2026 shall be extended for one year through March 1, 2027.

decisions.notes: Row is accurate and independently confirmed from the town's own official minutes/resolution document, including the exact adoption date (2026-03-04) and end date (2027-03-01) it already states. No changes needed.
